title: Mind the Long Tail: Understanding the Difficulty of Delay Detection in Business Processes
abstract: arXiv:2608.14367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The early detection of delayed cases in business processes is a critical capability for organizations. Predictive process monitoring (PPM) supports this task by using historical event logs to predict the remaining time of ongoing cases, enabling timely interventions to avoid missed deadlines and service level violations. Although remaining time prediction has advanced considerably through sophisticated deep learning architectures, little is known about the intrinsic difficulty of delay detection itself. Since performance is typically assessed using aggregate metrics, prior work provides limited insight into how models perform across the target distribution, especially on the operationally most critical cases with large delays. In this paper, we address this gap by analyzing the difficulty of delay detection. translated_title: 关注长尾：理解业务流程中延迟检测的难度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14367v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：业务流程中延迟案例的早期检测是组织的一项关键能力。预测性流程监控（PPM）通过使用历史事件日志预测进行中案例的剩余时间，支持这一任务，从而能够及时干预，避免错过截止日期和违反服务水平协议。尽管剩余时间预测通过复杂的深度学习架构已取得显著进展，但关于延迟检测本身的内在难度知之甚少。由于性能通常使用汇总指标进行评估，先前的工作对模型在目标分布上的表现提供的见解有限，尤其是在操作上最关键的大延迟案例上。在本文中，我们通过分析延迟检测的难度来填补这一空白。在14个事件日志中，我们表明剩余时间通常呈强烈右偏分布，只有一小部分案例表现出显著延迟。
tldr: 本文通过分析14个事件日志，揭示业务流程中剩余时间呈强右偏分布，延迟检测的难度主要集中在长尾的大延迟案例上，而传统汇总指标掩盖了这一关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes 14 event logs to reveal that remaining times in business processes are strongly right-skewed, with delay detection difficulty concentrated on long-tail cases with large delays, which aggregate metrics often obscure.
